//: With output:'export' there is no server, no routes-manifest.json and no
serverless functions - just HTML in out/. Pointing Vercel's Next.js
builder at that directory fails ('routes-manifest.json couldn't be
found'), and letting it auto-detect Next produced a 404 at the root.
framework:null tells Vercel to treat this as a plain static site and
serve outputDirectory verbatim, which is exactly what a static export is.
If the root still 404s, check the Vercel dashboard: Settings > Build and
Deployment. A dashboard override for Framework Preset or Output Directory
set before this file existed will keep winning.
